Definition: from G876; to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy):--foam.
BiblicalUsage: Twice, and both times about the same boy. His father tells Jesus the spirit tears him and he foams at the mouth in Mark 9:18, and when the boy is brought to Jesus in Mark 9:20 the spirit throws him down and he wallows foaming on the ground.
TheologicalSignificance: The word is only a symptom in the story; the point is the boy's torment and the disciples' failure, and then Jesus casting the spirit out.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
